description: Defines the LoanIdsHardLockedException class used for signaling a specific exception condition related to hard-locked loan IDs in the Fineract infrastructure jobs module.

classes.name: LoanIdsHardLockedException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating that loan IDs are hard-locked, containing a field for the loan ID from the request.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Constructor generated by Lombok's @RequiredArgsConstructor, initializes the exception with the loan ID.
